Description

Looking for cricket pitches in London? Take a look at the cricket facilities at Springfield Park. These are well maintained and with some peak slots occasionally available, it’s a great place to get a game of cricket at the time that suits you. Cricket equipment might be able to be provided by the facility but we suggest you call them to confirm it’s available.

Those driving are able to park free of charge at the facility. There are limited spaces available with weekends being particularly popular. The best parking availability is during the day and before 5pm.

Customers will be pleased to know that the venue operates a pay-as-you-play booking system. This means sports enthusiasts can just turn up and play depending on availability and book on a pay as you play basis. This method avoids the monthly membership charges and gives you the freedom to play as and when you like, without the commitment of a weekly game or a membership fee.

Looking to set up regular games at Springfield Park? Enquire about making a block booking to ensure you secure the time slot you want to play at every week. Block bookings are perfect for teams who want to be assured that they'll be playing regularly. A block booking is a booking made for a set number of consecutive weeks, on average this is 10 weeks.

The changing rooms on offer here are excellent. They are well-equipped and help to provide an additional excellence to this already outstanding sports facility.

The venue is situated near South Tottenham station. From there it is a short walk to the facility which works out well for a gentle warm down after your booking.
